title: Among all accounts that had at least one withdrawal (type = 'VYDAJ') in Jan
question: Among all accounts that had at least one withdrawal (type = 'VYDAJ') in January 1996, find the district name (A2) of the branch where the account with the smallest loan—approved before 1997 and with a duration over 24 months—is located.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_018
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT t.XCL_047
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.XCL_048 >= '1996-01-01'
      AND t.XCL_048 < '1996-02-01'
)
AND l.XCL_035 < '1997-01-01'
AND l.XCL_037 > 24
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.XCL_018
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT t.XCL_047
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.XCL_048 >= '1996-01-01'
      AND t.XCL_048 < '1996-02-01'
)
AND l.XCL_035 < '1997-01-01'
AND l.XCL_037 > 24
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_018
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    AND t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
    AND STRFTIME('%Y-%m', t.XCL_048) = '1996-01'
)
AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.XCL_035) < '1997'
AND l.XCL_037 > 24
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 ASC
LIMIT 1
